currentCard.prompt: В низкоскоростном ударе спереди или сзади какой наружный узел должен принять контакт и уменьшить физический ущерб концам автомобиля?

answers.note: По 49 CFR § 581.5(c)(2), после испытаний капот должен продолжать нормально работать.
Тот же критерий требует, чтобы после испытаний багажник продолжал нормально работать.
По § 581.5(c)(1), лампы не должны иметь трещин, а направление света фар должно регулироваться в допустимых пределах.
По 49 CFR Part 581, бампер испытывают маятником при 1,5 и 2,5 мили/ч, а затем барьером при 2,5 мили/ч спереди и сзади.

currentCard.explanation: Бампер принимает низкоскоростные удары спереди и сзади, чтобы уменьшить физическое повреждение концов автомобиля. Американский 49 CFR Part 581 устанавливает требования к ударопрочности в таких столкновениях. После испытаний проверяют также работу капота и багажника и целостность ламп.

literal.prompt: В низкоскоростном ударе спереди или сзади какой наружный узел должен принять контакт и уменьшить физический ущерб концам автомобиля?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The Part581 title and §§581.1-.2 identify low-speed front/rear damage reduction; §581.4 defines the bumper face bar as contacting the pendulum ridge. The factual key bumper is supported, not a crumple-zone claim. All answers are actual exterior parts, but recognizing their ordinary functions makes this question EASY rather than the frozen MEDIUM. See ABSOLUTE_MEDIUM_GENERIC_BUMPER_IDENTIFICATION.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Бампер принимает низкоскоростные удары спереди и сзади, чтобы уменьшить физическое повреждение концов автомобиля. Американский 49 CFR Part 581 устанавливает требования к ударопрочности в таких столкновениях. После испытаний проверяют также работу капота и багажника и целостность ламп.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: §§581.1-.2 establish low-speed front/rear impact resistance and reduced damage to passenger-vehicle ends. §581.5(c)(1)-(2) checks lamp cracks/aim and normal operation of hood/trunk. The explanation identifies the American regulation and does not claim occupant protection or energy absorption from the exhausted crumple source. §581.3 applicability and §581.6 conditions limit the legal tests; this is not a universal requirement for every vehicle or a guarantee of zero damage in any low-speed crash.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: По 49 CFR § 581.5(c)(2), после испытаний капот должен продолжать нормально работать.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: §581.5(c)(2) explicitly requires the hood to operate normally after the specified tests. The note has a precise section reference and teaches a concrete protective criterion for its own hood option.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Тот же критерий требует, чтобы после испытаний багажник продолжал нормально работать.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The same complete §581.5(c)(2) expressly includes the trunk. Its normal post-test operation is a concrete own-option fact. The note does not claim that the trunk is the impact-receiving protective assembly.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: По § 581.5(c)(1), лампы не должны иметь трещин, а направление света фар должно регулироваться в допустимых пределах.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The full §581.5(c)(1) requires covered lamps/reflectors to be crack-free, except license plate lamps, and each headlamp aim to remain adjustable within the specified inspection limits. The headlamp requirement is supported, but the note generalizes the no-cracks rule to lamps without the exception: LAMP_CRACK_RULE_EXCEPTION_OMITTED.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: По 49 CFR Part 581, бампер испытывают маятником при 1,5 и 2,5 мили/ч, а затем барьером при 2,5 мили/ч спереди и сзади.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: §581.5(a) specifies a 1.5 mph pendulum corner procedure and 2.5 mph longitudinal pendulum procedure followed by fixed-barrier forward/rear impacts at2.5 mph. §581.7 details the front/rear procedures; §581.6 supplies conditions. The note summarizes these specified bumper-standard vehicle tests, not testing a detached bumper or universal tests for every vehicle. Speeds and test types are additional facts beyond the primary bumper-function question.

absoluteLevel.assessed: easy in the actual question and row
absoluteLevel.ground: Bumper as the exterior assembly receiving small front/rear impacts is common adult road-user knowledge. Hood, trunk and headlamp are familiar parts with different everyday functions, so the row does not require thematic expertise. CFR test speeds and damage criteria appear only after answering in the notes; they do not raise the difficulty of selecting the key. Frozen MEDIUM remains an open quality gate, not permission to relabel it silently.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: Part581 uses pendulum tests at1.5/2.5 mph and subsequent forward/rear fixed-barrier impacts at2.5 mph.
correctNoteExtraFact.ground: The prompt/key asks about the bumper function, not test devices or speeds. These are concrete additional facts about testing the bumper-protected vehicle under §581.5(a), with §581.6 conditions and §581.3 applicability retained in the source assessment.

defects.finding: The actual question asks for the ordinary exterior assembly that takes small front/rear impacts, against hood, trunk and headlamp. Recognizing a bumper from this everyday purpose is broad adult road-user knowledge and the distractors have clearly different everyday functions. Choosing the key requires none of the CFR test details or technical distinction from the notes. The detailed correct note cannot make the primary question MEDIUM.
defects.requiredFix: Within the same supported bumper MAIN and frozen MEDIUM, use a meaningful thematic distinction or application that requires automotive familiarity, with a plausible row. Do not merely lengthen the wording, insert obscure section numbers, or adopt the exhausted shared crumpling claims from92/93. If no supported MEDIUM repair fits the authorized slice, retain HOLD rather than change the frozen level.
defects.recheckScope: Revised prompt/row and all changed full variants, actual absolute MEDIUM, key and source scope. This and the note exception below share the sole directed fix cycle.

defects.finding: The note reports that lamps must have no cracks under §581.5(c)(1). The complete provision expressly says each lamp or reflective device except license plate lamps. The unqualified plural lamps expands the rule beyond the source. The answer itself is headlamp, which is covered, so the note can be narrowed without discussing unrelated excluded equipment.
